snippet.title: Lunch Rush HD Game Trailer | Game for Mac, PC, iPhone, iPad
snippet.description:
Lunch Rush HD is a fast-pased and simple restaurent management game for PC, Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android.

Snowy the Bear opens his own eatery and offers fast-paced yet simple fun. 
Seat hungry customers, take orders, serve food, collect cash and clear tables. Match colors, chain actions and keep your customers happy to earn big tips! Deal with VIPs and don't miss impatient drivers. 
Earn money to keep the restaurant open and upgrade to better and bigger locations!
